title: Emmy Noether: Modern LaTeX Working Corpus and Multilingual Translation Drafts (R805 Source-Control Update)
description:
This is the reader-facing Emmy Noether working record for the Modern LaTeX Editions of Mathematics Manuscripts project. This version updates the German/source-control head to R805 and fronts 00_Noether_German_Cumulative_Working_SourceControl_R805_20260707.pdf.

New in this version: a narrow Paper 19 printed p57 E-family correction packet, 08_Noether_SourceRepair_Audit_R805_P19p57_EFamilyCorrection_20260707.zip, containing cum_de_R805.tex/.pdf, source crops, before/after render checks, diff, audit CSVs, compile logs, and stage notes. The earlier R804/v11 source-control packet remains preserved as file 07.

Status caveat: this is a serious source-repair and translation working corpus, not OCR-only, but it is not a critical edition and not a globally certified final Noether corpus. This R805 update is not Noether closure, not paper-level certification, not whole-corpus source-faithfulness certification, and not multilingual synchronization proof. Filenames containing COMPLETE are inherited local-task labels only.

GitHub: corrections, source comparisons, LaTeX fixes, and translation improvements can be suggested via issues or pull requests at https://github.com/KokunoYumeto/modern-latex-manuscripts.
notes: Reader-first public surface with R805 source-control update. Not a critical edition, not a global source-faithfulness certification, and not a complete multilingual synchronization.
